question: In March 2025, which region was announced as the site for the world’s first high-altitude para sports centre to boost preparations for the 2028 Paralympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leh, Ladakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In March 2025, the region of **Leh, Ladakh** was announced as the site for the world's first high-altitude para sports centre.
 
• The initiative aims to boost preparations for the **2028 Paralympics**, enhancing India's global competitiveness in para-sports.
 
• The high-altitude environment in Leh is ideal for training athletes, as it helps improve **endurance and performance** by acclimatizing them to challenging conditions.
 
• The centre will also focus on **training, rehabilitation, and research** for para-athletes, making it a hub for innovation in para-sports.
 
• This project reflects India's commitment to developing infrastructure for para-sports and promoting inclusivity in athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Leh, Ladakh:**

 
 
• Situated at an altitude of approximately 3,500 meters above sea level, Leh is known for its challenging terrain and high-altitude environment.
 
• The region provides natural conditions that mimic high-performance training environments, essential for athletes preparing for international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Paralympics:**
 
 
• The Paralympics is a major international multi-sport event involving athletes with disabilities.
 
• The 2028 Paralympics will be held in **Los Angeles, USA**.
 
 
 
• **High-altitude Training Benefits:**
 
 
• Training at high altitudes increases red blood cell production, improving oxygen delivery to muscles.
 
• This enhances **athletic performance and endurance**, especially in endurance sports.
 
 
 
• **India's Para-sports Development:**
 
 
• India has been investing in para-sports infrastructure and athlete development to improve its global standing.
 
• Initiatives like the high-altitude centre in Leh signify a strong push towards inclusivity and excellence in sports.
